To set up a custom domain for your support portal, add two DNS records at your domain’s DNS provider:
1. **CNAME** – points the subdomain you want to use (e.g., support.yourcompany.com) to Meridian’s portal address.
2. **TXT** – used to verify you own the domain before the custom domain is activated.
You can view the exact values to enter after you type your domain in Settings → General → Custom domain. After the records are added, verification runs automatically and may take up to your DNS provider’s propagation time.
